title: transition.zig's 26 in-file tests wired into no build target; never ran and rotted
registered_by: Pipeline audit Step 3 (discovered while adding ISS-0132 alloc-failure harness)
scope: Engine unit-test coverage. No production impact; zig build / test / integration all green.
symptom: src/engine/transition.zig has 26 test blocks that never executed: build.zig referenced the file only as an imported module (transition_mod), never as an addTest root. Once wired, 26 compile errors surfaced from drift against a Zig stdlib upgrade and InstanceState/slice refactors. After fixing compilation: 23/30 pass, 5 leak, 2 crash.
root_cause_analysis: Leaks are test-side: processNodeEntry returns an owned InstanceState that production callers free via freeInstanceState but these tests do not. Adding defer freeInstanceState naively regresses 23->22 passing because fixtures build InstanceState from string literals, so the free double-frees (source of the two exit-code-3 crashes). Each test needs individual fixture-ownership rework. TC-EE-02-02 is an assertion failure, possibly a genuine engine defect.
acceptance_criteria: All 30 transition.zig tests pass with no DebugAllocator leaks
Fixture ownership reworked per test so freeInstanceState is safe
TC-EE-02-02 triaged: genuine defect vs stale expectation
A check exists that fails when a file's test blocks are wired into no build target
evidence_file: GH #428 contains the full per-test failure table
